Name: Broken Bog's Witchy House
Author: SeraphineDreams
Description:
I absolutely adore [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34624]Bog's Witchy Farm Buildings Mod by BogWyytch[/url] and was using them when I first found the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17466]Broken Farmhouse mod by glymr[/url], which I am also deeply in love with. So I made a personal mod to merge them.

The Broken Farmhouse starts off with the full house, it's just so run down after so many years with no one living there that parts are unusable. You then repair it slowly, and upgrade it as you do. So having the house start off small on the outside and get bigger as you upgrade it doesn't really make sense and drove me nuts. I decided to take the final house from Bog's Witchy Farm Buildings and see if I could break it down to match. I loved the result, and use it constantly for my own games.

So with the permission of both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/glymr]glymr[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/210387900]BogWyytch[/url] and without further ado, here is the Broken Bog's Witchy House for your entertainment!

P.S. Ok, a little more ado, there's also an option to recolor the mailbox to match better, if anyone wants.
P.P.S. Should I make Broken versions of the cabins? 
P.P.P.S Breaking down houses is the most fun thing ever, so if anyone wants to request another mod, I can always ask their mod authors for permission to make a Broken version!

Instructions
1. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]!
2. Download file
3. Place file in mod folder
4. Have fun!
5. Beat the game! (I still haven't beaten it and I have 2,731.1 hours in the game. Seriously, I have a problem, I keep restarting the game. Farthest I've gotten is summer year 2.)

By the way, no AI was used for this mod. Mostly because I'm not sure how one uses AI to begin with. Would I use AI to help with code? Maybe. It seems easier than downloading 15 different mods, looking at how they are written, and trying to cobble them together in a way that actually does the things I want. I hate coding. I do it myself, but that doesn't mean I like it.
